column1: # Unpacking (Unity 2019.4.34f1 IL2CPP with Wwise on SDK 13.3.2, update 2.01 = v327680). Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py); checked by hand
# against the survey on 2026-10-26: the modules (subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library, the Humble Games logo intro is an H.264 MP4; sdk and subsdk0 are Bayonetta 3's builds), the 5 GB
# guest layout of a game with virtual address memory whose nninitStartup hands pool - used to StandardAllocator as one address region (sdk_patches.py cuts the node area and the 1 GB
# region alignment on its sdk build, or Unity's own regions ran out), the 16 MB system resource from the NPDM. Its shaders are the Unity 2019.4 Shader and ComputeShader objects in
# Data/*.assets and Data/Resources, which carry no type trees (unityfs.py has the 2019.4 layouts). On Android it plays with these keys (android.tsv)
